For countries with GDP per capita above 40k USD, what is the range of CO2 per capita? (A) 0-10 t (B) 15-40 t (C) 3-38 t. Answer with just the letter.

Among the countries with GDP per capita above 40k USD, CO2 per capita runs from about 3.5 t at the low end to about 38 t at the top. That matches option C (3–38 t).

**C**
